source_notes: English Unit 2 runs on printed pages 119–131, while the Tamil edition begins on printed page 117 and reaches page 131; questions store separate English and Tamil printed-page references.
The Stages of Human Evolution diagram was read visually because most labels and time ranges are embedded in the image rather than parsed text.
Only clearly readable diagram/map facts were used; ambiguous or visually uncertain route dates on the migration map were not converted into answerable facts.
The HOTS prompts are represented as source-supported reasoning prompts; the bank does not invent textbook answers where the chapter does not supply one.
The chapter’s wording and classifications are preserved as printed, including the statement that the wheel was the first/foremost scientific invention.
meta.question_style: Natural competitive-exam wording; no routine 'according to the textbook' phrasing.
meta.quality_policy: Competitive-exam useful questions only. Classroom stories, activity props, learning-objective recall, ICT steps, picture trivia and low-value procedural questions removed.
